Title: Windows webview backend fails to launch (blank/hidden window, no serve)
Description: deno desktop --backend webview on Windows 11 (Deno 2.9.5): full app compiles and laufey webview backend runs with no errors, but no window appears (MainWindowHandle 0) and no serve port binds. Minimal repro (Deno.serve only, no bindings) exits immediately with code 0. Root cause: denoland/deno#35645 (app:// scheme regression); fix #35670 landed 2026-07-01 but regressed between canaries (blank/hang on ddebb900558c, 2026-07-10). Issue still open, assigned.
Fix: None in 2.9.5. Workaround: backend cef (current). Revisit when #35645 closes and a stable Deno ships the fix; then one-line change to webview + smoke test. Note: WebView2 sanitizes input[type=file] paths — browse() would need the Deno-side prompt() fallback.
Notes: Verified 2026-08-18 on Deno 2.9.5 (latest stable). CEF backend unaffected.

Title: deno task test fails: missing --allow-run for vips subprocess tests
Description: The test task runs deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-ffi --no-check — no --allow-run. Compressor/scanner tests spawn vips.exe; all fail with NotCapable: Requires run access to vendor/vips/bin/vips.exe.
Fix: Add --allow-run to the test task in deno.json.
Notes: Verified 2026-08-18: 8/10 compressor tests fail without the flag, 10/10 pass with it.

Title: Dev restart fails with Access is denied — Compressy.dll locked by lingering laufey
Description: Restarting deno task dev while a previous instance's laufey/deno processes still run fails at compile with error: Access is denied. (os error 5) — the compiled DLL is file-locked.
Fix: Kill lingering laufey.exe/deno.exe processes before restarting dev.
